title: Monthly installment of a payment plan on a Continence Commercial HMO Program
content:
The monthly installment of an interest-free payment plan for the balance of a Continence Commercial HMO Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program is worked from the program's ledger when the plan is accepted.

## Covered balance

The covered balance is the program's balance. It is the program's remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds, less its payments and balance adjustments.

## Installment

1. **Term.** The term is the tier's longest plan term in months.
2. **Installments recorded on the plan.** These are the term's months, never fewer than one.
3. **Amount spread.** The amount spread is the covered balance.
4. **Installment.** The installment is the amount spread divided by the installments recorded on the plan. It is rounded up to the next cent and is never below the tier's smallest monthly installment.

Each adjustment to the plan changes it as that adjustment states. Every replacement of a standard quantity is made first, then every addition to or subtraction from one, and the quantities resting on them are counted again. The installment is then counted as set out in this section.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Assume a longest plan term of 6 months and a smallest monthly installment of 25.00 USD.

| Covered balance | Division | Installment |
|---|---|---|
| 500.00 USD | 500.00 divided by 6 is 83.333 | 83.34 USD, rounded up to the next cent |
| 120.00 USD | 120.00 divided by 6 is 20.00 | 25.00 USD, because it is never below the smallest monthly installment |
